# Pinned private xdotool source

This directory vendors the exact upstream source archive used for Crowley's
private XTEST emitter. It is source only; the compiled executable is built into
the user's private cache by `tools/build_crowley_xdotool.py`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/jordansissel/xdotool/commit/14ca26a2c95035f9c635a6a11d075e8d7d0d6529
